verdict.rationale: Multiple documentation excerpts (endpoint descriptions for certificates, tax IDs, address resolution, filings, product mappings, transactions) come directly from https://apidocs.anrok.com/openapi.yaml, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly fetchable. The probe's 404s covered only JSON/swagger paths, not the YAML file, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit docs advertising or linking the spec download, a JSON variant at standard paths, versioning info for the spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of using it with tooling.
